source.notes: Korean-localized recomposition of a human-produced first-date wrong-recipient text anecdote. Four-year update later reported that the pair had married; final card is framed as a later update, not a claim that the wedding occurred exactly four years after the text.

episode_only.role: POV woman on first date with a three-year friend
episode_only.identity_digest: Korean woman in her late twenties; collarbone-length very dark brown hair with a soft inward curve and thin side fringe; softly rounded face with slightly narrow chin; large round v2 eyes; ivory knit top and muted blue straight jeans on slides 1-6; no glasses, jewelry, bag, or shoulder strap; ordinary expressive face, deliberately not generic AI-pretty; slide 7 changes clothing only to a simple white wedding dress while preserving face and hair.

episode_only.role: three-year male friend and first-date partner
episode_only.identity_digest: Korean man in his late twenties; dark brown compact short hair with a clear 6:4 side part, visually distinct from Taemin; slightly longer face, soft straight eyebrows, large round v2 eyes; muted olive overshirt/cardigan over plain white T-shirt with charcoal trousers on slides 1-2; no glasses, facial hair, jewelry, bag, or shoulder strap; warm restrained ordinary expression, not generic handsome-AI styling; slide 7 changes clothing only to a simple black wedding suit while preserving face and hair.
